brief:
Shehab Wire reported that the war in Gaza has exposed a class of crisis profiteers who have seized on civilian suffering to accumulate wealth. These traders have exploited citizen needs and shortages, converting humanitarian desperation into financial gain through coordination mechanisms linked to occupation authorities.

The reporting characterizes the phenomenon as distinct from the documented catastrophe of mass casualties, destruction, hunger, and displacement that has marked the conflict, framing opportunistic commerce as a parallel dimension of the broader crisis.

title: Gaza merchants profit from occupation coordination during war
